name: resolution
description: Resolution advisories (14 CFR 107.37(a), the drone gives way): an aircraft above, level (within 30 m) or of unknown height -> descend and land; more than 30 m below -> move directly away and land; closest approach in the geometry when known.
worked_example: 14 CFR 107.37(a): the drone yields the right of way. Drone D9A11 hovers at alt_geo 100 m.
b10002: vertical -80.0 m -> below -> 'GIVE WAY: MOVE SW, THEN LAND D9A11; AIRCRAFT 80 M BELOW, 500 M NE'.
b10001: vertical +20.0 m -> level -> 'GIVE WAY: DESCEND AND LAND D9A11; AIRCRAFT LEVEL WITHIN 30 M, 600 M E'.
b10005: vertical unknown -> unknown -> 'GIVE WAY: DESCEND AND LAND D9A11; AIRCRAFT HEIGHT UNKNOWN, 700 M S'.
b10003: vertical +140.0 m -> above -> 'GIVE WAY: DESCEND AND LAND D9A11; AIRCRAFT 140 M ABOVE, 900 M N, CLOSEST IN 17 S'.
b10004: vertical +10.0 m -> level -> 'GIVE WAY: DESCEND AND LAND D9A11; AIRCRAFT LEVEL WITHIN 30 M, 2.0 KM W, CLOSEST IN 32 S'.
Below (more than 30 m): descending would close on the aircraft, so move directly away from it (the opposite 8-point direction) and land.
